body:
다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?
Have you ever wondered, "What if I could run so fast that nobody could see me?" If you have asked this kind of question, you may be ready to become the next Galileo. The Italian scientist Galileo Galilei is famous for a thought experiment, which is an imaginary experiment designed to explore a mathematical or scientific hypothesis. With only his thoughts, he demonstrated that objects with different masses should fall at the same speed when dropped from the same height in the absence of air resistance. With a hypothesis based on creativity and imagination, anyone can become a great scientist.
solution: ① 글의 마지막 문장 "With a hypothesis based on creativity and imagination, anyone can become a great scientist."에서 창의성과 상상력을 바탕으로 한 가설이 있으면 누구나 훌륭한 과학자가 될 수 있다고 직접 언급하고 있으므로, 글의 요지로 가장 적절하다. ② 갈릴레오는 실제 실험이 아니라 사고 실험(thought experiment)으로 자신의 가설을 입증했으므로 본문의 내용과 반대된다. ③ 빨리 달리는 것은 글 도입부의 예시적 질문일 뿐, 글 전체의 요지와는 무관하다. ④ 사고 실험이 수학에만 유용하다는 내용은 언급되지 않았다. ⑤ 공기 저항(air resistance)은 갈릴레오의 사고 실험을 설명하는 세부 사항일 뿐, 글 전체의 요지는 아니다.
choices: Creativity and imagination can make anyone a great scientist.
Galileo proved his ideas by conducting real experiments.
Running fast requires a strong scientific background.
Thought experiments are only useful in mathematics.
Air resistance is the key factor in all scientific studies.

These changes can create many problems that would put the giant's life in danger. The tallest man in recorded history was 272 cm tall, but have you ever wondered what would happen if humans could grow to enormous sizes like the giant in Jack and the Beanstalk? Unfortunately, the answer to this hypothetical question is that it is impossible due to the scale effect. ( ⓐ ) When the length of an object doubles, its area increases by a factor of four (2×2), and its volume by a factor of eight (2×2×2). ( ⓑ ) One issue is that the giant would not be able to stand properly on his own because of the weight pushing down on his feet. ( ⓒ ) If a person's height increased ten times, his weight would increase by a factor of 1,000 (10×10×10) because weight changes in proportion to volume. ( ⓓ ) However, the area of the feet supporting his body would only increase by a factor of 100 (10×10). ( ⓔ ) This means that his feet would be under too much pressure to support the increased weight because the mass would have increased far more than the area of his feet.
solution: 주어진 문장은 'These changes'라는 지시어로 앞 문장의 내용을 받아 이러한 변화들이 거인의 생명을 위협하는 여러 문제를 야기할 수 있다고 마무리하므로, 앞에는 넓이와 부피의 수치적 변화가 제시되어야 하고 뒤에는 그 구체적인 문제 사례가 시작되어야 한다. ⓑ 앞 문장에서 길이가 두 배가 되면 면적은 4배, 부피는 8배 증가한다는 수치 변화가 설명되고, ⓑ 이후에는 'One issue is that ~'으로 시작하는 첫 번째 구체적인 문제가 바로 제시된다. 따라서 수치 설명을 받아 문제 제기로 연결하는 ② ⓑ 자리에 들어가는 것이 자연스럽다.

body:
다음 글의 내용을 한 문장으로 요약하고자 한다. 빈칸 (A),
(B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
The tallest man in recorded history was 272 cm tall, but have you ever wondered what would happen if humans could grow to enormous sizes like the giant in Jack and the Beanstalk? Unfortunately, the answer to this hypothetical question is that it is impossible due to the scale effect. When the length of an object doubles, its area increases by a factor of four (2×2), and its volume by a factor of eight (2×2×2). These changes can create many problems that would put the giant's life in danger. One issue is that the giant would not be able to stand properly on his own because of the weight pushing down on his feet. If a person's height increased ten times, his weight would increase by a factor of 1,000 (10×10×10) because weight changes in proportion to volume. However, the area of the feet supporting his body would only increase by a factor of 100 (10×10). This means that his feet would be under too much pressure to support the increased weight because the mass would have increased far more than the area of his feet. Because body (A) _____ grows far faster than the surface area of the feet, a giant human could not (B) _____ its own weight.
solution: (A) 지문에서 키가 10배 커지면 몸무게(체질량)는 부피에 비례하여 1,000배 증가하는 반면 발바닥 면적은 100배밖에 늘지 않는다고 했으므로, 발바닥 면적보다 훨씬 빠르게 증가하는 것은 '질량(mass)'이 가장 적절하다. (B) 질량이 발바닥 면적보다 훨씬 더 크게 늘어나 발이 압력을 견디지 못한다고 했으므로, 거대 인간이 자신의 체중을 '지탱하다(support)'는 것이 가장 적절하다.
choices: mass - support
mass - distribute
length - support
volume - reduce
length - distribute

Additionally, the absence of the Moon would completely change weather patterns on Earth. We experience the beauty of different seasons because the Earth is ⓐtilted on its axis. The axis of rotation of the Earth is tilted at an angle of 23.5 degrees, and the Moon's gravity holds the Earth in place by ⓑstabilizing the tilt. However, if there
ⓒwere no Moon, the tilt could vary wildly between 0 and 85 degrees. Suppose the Earth were tilted at an angle of 60 degrees. The hemisphere of the Earth ⓓfaced the Sun would receive much more energy from the sun than the other hemisphere. This could bring about extreme shifts in weather patterns, potentially ⓔmaking summers hotter and winters colder. If this trend continued, the Earth would become uninhabitable.
solution: ④ faced → facing 'The hemisphere of the Earth faced the Sun'에서 hemisphere는 태양을 능동적으로 '향하고 있는' 주체이다. 따라서 명사 hemisphere를 수식하는 분사는 능동의 의미를 나타내는 현재분사 facing이어야 한다. 과거분사 faced는 수동의 의미('태양에 의해 향해지는')를 나타내므로 문맥상 어법에 맞지 않는다. 따라서 ④가 정답이다. ① 'the Earth is tilted on its axis'에서 Earth는 축에 기울어진 상태의 대상이므로 수동의 의미를 나타내는 과거분사 tilted가 서술적 용법으로 올바르게 쓰였다. ② 전치사 by 뒤에는 동명사가 와야 하므로, stabilizing이 올바르게 쓰였다. ③ 'if there were no Moon'은 현재 사실과 반대되는 상황을 가정하는 가정법 과거 구문으로, were가 올바르게 쓰였다. ⑤ 'potentially making summers hotter and winters colder'는 앞 문장 전체를 의미상 주어로 하는 분사구문으로, 능동의 의미를 나타내는 현재분사 making이 올바르게 쓰였다.

solution: ① 밑줄 친 'the Earth would become uninhabitable'은 지구가 거주 불가능한 상태가 될 것이라는 뜻으로, 밑줄 앞에서 달이 없으면 지구의 자전축 기울기가 0도에서 85도까지 불규칙하게 변하고, 60도로 기울어질 경우 태양을 향한 반구가 훨씬 많은 에너지를 받아 여름은 더 뜨겁고 겨울은 더 추워지는 극단적인 기상 변화가 초래된다고 했으므로, 밑줄 친 부분에는 '어떤 생물도 지구에서 생존할 수 없게 된다'라는 의미가 와야 자연스럽다. 따라서 ①이 정답이다.
choices: no living creature could survive on Earth.
the Moon's gravity would stop functioning permanently.
weather patterns would stabilize at 60 degrees of tilt.
the hemisphere facing the Sun would grow colder over time.
seasons would become more beautiful due to extreme tilt.

body:
다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
"O, swear not by the moon, the inconstant moon." This is a famous line from Romeo and Juliet. Juliet warns Romeo not to swear his love by the Moon as it may change just as the Moon changes its shape. Although its appearance changes, the Moon is always present in the night sky and plays a crucial role in regulating the length of the day on Earth as well as the Earth's seasons and weather patterns. Then, what would happen if there were no Moon? Without the Moon, our day would no longer be 24 hours. The Moon's gravity causes the Earth's ocean to rise and fall. Since the ocean is moving and the Earth is also spinning, friction occurs between them. This friction leads to a decrease in the rotation rate of the planet. Without the Moon, however, the Earth's rotation would not slow down, resulting in a change in the length of a day. According to some scientists, when the Earth first formed, there was no Moon and a day was only five hours long. This indicates that without the Moon, _____ .
solution: ① 빈칸은 글의 마지막 문장에 위치하며, 바로 앞에서 과학자들의 연구에 따르면 지구가 처음 형성되었을 때 달이 없었고 하루가 단 다섯 시간에 불과했다는 내용이 제시되어 있다. 빈칸이 포함된 문장은 'This indicates that ~'으로, 앞 문장의 내용을 근거로 달이 없을 경우 나타나는 결론을 도출하는 자리이다. 따라서 빈칸에는 달이 없으면 하루가 다섯 시간으로 줄어들어 태양이 다섯 시간마다 뜨는 것을 보게 된다는 내용이 와야 한다. 따라서 'we would see the Sun rise every five hours'이 흐름상 가장 자연스럽다.
choices: we would see the Sun rise every five hours
the Moon's gravity would pull the ocean more strongly
the Earth's rotation rate would gradually slow to a stop
seasons and weather patterns would become more stable
the length of a day would be regulated by ocean friction

Since the ocean is moving and the Earth is also spinning, friction occurs between them. This friction leads to a decrease in the rotation rate of the planet. Without the Moon, however, the Earth's rotation would not slow down, resulting in a change in the length of a day.
According to some scientists, when the Earth first formed, there was no Moon and a day was only five hours long. This indicates that without the Moon, we would see the Sun rise every five hours.
solution: ①이 정답이다. 지문은 달이 없다면 지구의 하루 길이가 달라진다는 내용을 중심으로, 달이 지구의 자전 속도와 하루 길이를 조절하는 역할을 한다고 설명하므로, 글의 주제로 가장 적절하다. ② Romeo and Juliet의 유명한 대사는 도입부의 예시일 뿐, 글 전체의 주제가 아니다. ③ 달이 모양을 바꾼다는 내용은 잠깐 언급될 뿐이며, 글의 핵심은 달의 유무가 하루 길이에 미치는 영향이다. ④ 달의 중력 연구 역사는 언급되지 않았다. ⑤ 지구의 자전 속도를 측정하는 방법은 언급되지 않았다.

How the Moon changes its shape every night
The history of studying the Moon's gravity
Ways to measure the Earth's rotation speed

body:
밑줄 친 우리말 문장을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
In addition, there is an issue of heat emission. Heat is generated in the human body, and it is constantly released from the surface of the skin to prevent heat from accumulating in the body. If a person's height were to increase ten times, the amount of heat generated would increase a thousand times in proportion to the body's volume. However, the surface area of the person's skin would only increase a hundred times, and as a result, not enough heat would be released from the body through the skin. 이것은 우리가 거인처럼 키 가 크기를 바랄 수도 있지만, 우리는 그 형태로는 살아남을 수 없을 것임을 보여준다.
조건 1. 접속사(while, that)를 모두 사용할 것
2. [ show, we, wish, grow, tall, a giant, survive, that form ] 을 모두 포함할 것
3. 필요 시 어형을 변형할 것
→
answer: This shows that while we may wish to grow as tall as a giant, we would not be able to survive in that form.
solution: 정답 문장은 'This shows that while we may wish to grow as tall as a giant, we would not be able to survive in that form.'이다. 먼저 'show'는 주어 'This'에 맞춰 3인칭 단수 현재형 'shows'로 변형한다. 명사절 접속사 'that'을 사용하여 'shows'의 목적어절을 이끌고, 그 안에 양보의 부사절 접속사 'while'을 사용하여 'while we may wish to grow as tall as a giant'를 삽입한다. 'tall'은 'as tall as' 원급 비교 구조에 맞게 그대로 사용하며, 'a giant'도 그대로 쓴다. 주절은 'we would not be able to survive in that form'으로 구성하고, 'survive'는 원형 그대로 사용한다. 박스에서 제공된 'show, we, wish, grow, tall, a giant, survive, that form'을 모두 활용하되, 문법 조건에 해당하는 'that'(명사절)과 'while'(부사절)은 박스에서 제외되었으므로 학생이 스스로 추가해야 한다.

body:
다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.
The tallest man in recorded history was 272 cm tall, but have you ever wondered what would happen if humans could grow to enormous sizes like the giant in Jack and the Beanstalk? Unfortunately, the answer to this hypothetical question is that it is ⓐimpossible due to the scale effect. When the length of an object doubles, its area increases by a factor of four (2×2), and its volume by a factor of eight (2×2×2). These changes can create many problems that would put the giant’s life in danger. One issue is that the giant would not be able to stand properly on his own because of the weight pushing down on his feet. If a person’s height increased ten times, his weight would increase by a factor of 1,000 (10×10×10) because weight changes in ⓑproportion to volume. However, the area of the feet supporting his body would only increase by a factor of 100 (10×10). This means that his feet would be under too much pressure to support the increased weight because the mass would have increased far ⓒless than the area of his feet. In addition, there is an issue of heat emission. Heat is generated in the human body, and it is constantly released from the surface of the skin to prevent heat from
ⓓaccumulating in the body. If a person’s height were to increase ten times, the amount of heat generated would increase a thousand times in proportion to the body’s volume. However, the surface area of the person’s skin would only increase a hundred times, and as a result, not enough heat would be released from the body through the skin. This shows that while we may wish to grow as tall as a giant, we would not be able to ⓔsurvive in that form.

위 글의 내용을 한 문장으로 요약하고자 한다. 빈칸 (A),
(B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
Due to the scale effect, a giant human body would experience (A) _____ heat release along with extreme weight pressure, making survival physically (B) _____ .
solution: (A) 본문의 'not enough heat would be released'라는 표현을 통해 신체를 통한 열 방출이 불충분하다는 것을 알 수 있으므로 'deficient(부족한)'가 가장 적절하다. (B) 지문 마지막 문장의 'we would not be able to survive in that form'이라는 표현을 통해 이러한 형태로는 생존이 불가능함을 의미하므로 'impossible(불가능한)'이 가장 적절하다.
choices: deficient - impossible
abundant - unsustainable
sufficient - plausible
inadequate - achievable
excessive - unviable

solution: ⓒ less → more 지문의 흐름상 키가 10배 커질 때 질량(체중)은 1,000배 증가하고 발의 면적은 100배 증가하므로, 질량이 발의 면적보다 '훨씬 더 많이' 증가했다는 내용이 되어야 한다. 따라서 less(더 적은)를 more(더 많은) 등으로 바꿔야 한다. ⓐ impossible: 불가능한 ⓑ proportion: 비례 ⓓ accumulating: 축적되는 것 ⓔ survive: 생존하다

body:
다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.
Oxygen is a vital gas for life, making up 21 percent of the Earth’s atmosphere. It is essential for breathing and is also necessary ⓐto burn common fuels like wood and oil to generate heat and light. Undoubtedly, it is an indispensable element for organisms on Earth. Then, would it be better to have a higher concentration of oxygen in the atmosphere? What ⓑwill happen if the oxygen concentration were to double? While more oxygen may seem beneficial, it could have unexpected consequences, especially for insects. Insects, such as bees and dragonflies, do not have lungs and instead take in air through external openings called spiracles. Although insects can survive without lungs, their spiracles are not as ⓒefficiently as lungs at taking in air. Therefore, with the current oxygen concentration, insects cannot evolve to be larger than their current size. If they ⓓwere bigger in size, oxygen would not be able to reach the deepest parts of their bodies. However, if the concentration of oxygen were to double, insects could grow in size as oxygen would be more ⓔreadily available. This increase in insect size could have a significant influence on the ecological environment, potentially ⓕdisrupted the food chain. Dragonflies, for example, may become as large as eagles, altering the balance of predators and prey in the ecosystem. Fortunately, you wouldn’t need to worry about giant insects chasing after you if this were to occur. If the oxygen concentration were to double, you would be able to run faster than you can right now. Considering that oxygen is used to break down energy ⓖso that muscles can use it, the increase in oxygen would help to use energy more efficiently and improve our capability for physical exercise. This leads us ⓗto expect that athletes would set new world records at the Olympics.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓗ 중, 어법상 어색한 것의 개수는?
solution: ⓑ will happen → would happen if절이 "were to double"이라는 가정법 과거시제로 쓰였으므로, 주절의 동사도 이에 맞춰 조동사의 과거형인 would happen이 되어야 한다. ⓒ efficiently → efficient 원급 비교 구문 'as + 형용사/부사 + as'에서, be동사 are의 보어 자리이므로 부사 efficiently가 아니라 형용사 efficient가 되어야 한다. ⓕ disrupted → disrupting 앞 문장 내용에 대한 부가적 설명을 나타내는 분사구문 자리이며, 곤충 크기의 증가가 먹이사슬을 '교란시키는' 능동의 의미이므로 과거형 disrupted가 아니라 현재분사 disrupting이 되어야 한다. ⓐ be동사 뒤에서 '~하는 데 필요한'이라는 의미로 형용사 necessary를 수식하는 to부정사의 부사적 용법이다. ⓓ 현재 사실과 반대되는 비현실적 상상을 나타내는 가정법 과거이므로, if절의 동사를 과거형인 were로 나타낸다. ⓔ '더 쉽게, 더 준비된 상태로'라는 의미로 형용사 available을 수식하는 부사이다. ⓖ '~하도록'이라는 목적을 나타내는 접속사이므로 so that이 올바르게 쓰였다. ⓗ lead는 목적격보어로 to부정사를 취하는 동사이므로 to expect가 올바르게 쓰였다.
choices: 1개
2개
3개
4개
5개

Exploring Idioms: From Love to Rare Occurrences Have you ever heard the expression “I love you to the moon and back”? This expression conveys a deep extent of love, and uses the great distance between the Earth and the Moon as a metaphor. While this expression is easily understood, there are idioms with a scientific background that may not be so obvious. One example is the phrase once in a blue moon. Although people may have seen a magnificent full moon brightening the night sky or a tiny crescent resembling a clipped fingernail, it is highly unlikely that they have seen a blue moon. Surprisingly, this extraordinary event does occur. Normally, there is only one full moon in a month. However, every 2.5 years, there can be two full moons in the same month. The second moon is called a “blue moon,” and it occurs because the Moon completes its cycle of phases in only about 29.5 days. From this rare phenomenon of a blue moon emerged the use of the expression “once in a blue moon.” It describes something that happens exceptionally rarely.
solution: 이 글은 한 달에 두 번 보름달이 뜨는 천문학적 현상인 '블루문'에서 유래한 관용구를 소개하고 있다. 지문 마지막 문장에서 이 표현이 매우 드물게 일어나는 일을 묘사한다고 명시하고 있으므로 밑줄 친 부분은 '매우 드문 경우에'를 의미한다. 따라서 지문의 핵심 설명인 'exceptionally rarely'를 가장 잘 나타낸 ②이 정답이며, 나머지 선택지들은 지문의 소재를 단순 조합했거나 반대되는 의미를 담고 있다.

Have you ever wondered, "What if I could run so fast that nobody could see me?" If you have asked this kind of question, you may be ready to become the next Galileo. The Italian scientist Galileo Galilei is famous for a thought experiment, which is an imaginary experiment designed to explore a mathematical or scientific hypothesis. With only his thoughts, he demonstrated that objects with different masses should fall at the same speed when dropped from the same height in the absence of air resistance. With a hypothesis based on creativity and imagination, anyone can become a great scientist.

다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.
“O, swear not by the moon, the inconstant moon.” This is a famous line from Romeo and Juliet. Juliet warns Romeo not to swear his love by the Moon as it may change just as the Moon changes its shape. Although its appearance changes, the Moon is always present in the night sky and ⓐplays a crucial role in regulating the length of the day on Earth as well as the Earth’s seasons and weather patterns. Then, what would happen if there were no Moon? 2회차 실전 모의고사 Without the Moon, our day would no longer be 24 hours.
The Moon’s gravity causes the Earth’s ocean to rise and fall. Since the ocean is moving and the Earth is also spinning, friction occurs between them. This friction leads to a decrease in the rotation rate of the planet. Without the Moon, however, the Earth’s rotation would not slow down, ⓑresulted in a change in the length of a day. According to some scientists, when the Earth first
ⓒformed, there was no Moon and a day was only five hours long. This indicates that without the Moon, we would see the Sun rise every five hours. Additionally, the absence of the Moon would completely change weather patterns on Earth. We experience the beauty of different seasons because the Earth is tilted on its axis. The axis of rotation of the Earth is tilted at an angle of 23.5 degrees, and the Moon’s gravity holds the Earth in place by stabilizing the tilt. However, if there were no Moon, the tilt could vary wildly between 0 and 85 degrees. Suppose the Earth were tilted at an angle of 60 degrees. The hemisphere of the Earth ⓓfacing the Sun would receive much more energy from the sun than the other hemisphere. This could bring about extreme shifts in weather patterns, potentially ⓔmaking summers hotter and winters colder. If this trend continued, the Earth would become uninhabitable.

위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
solution: ⑤ 달이 지구의 자전 속도 조절, 자전축 안정화, 기후 패턴 유지에 핵심적인 역할을 하며 달이 없으면 생존이 어려워진다고 서술하고 있으므로, 글의 주제로 가장 적절하다. ① 초기 지구의 5시간 하루 길이는 달의 영향을 설명하기 위한 구체적인 예시일 뿐, 전체 주제를 포괄하지 못한다. ② 지구의 중력이 달의 표면을 지속적으로 형성한다는 내용은 언급되지 않았다. ③ 달의 중력이 지구 자전축과 계절에 미치는 영향이 미미하다는 내용은 지문의 내용과 정반대이다. ④ 해양 마찰과 자전 속도의 관계는 달이 지구 환경을 조절하는 원리를 설명하는 일부분일 뿐, 글 전체의 핵심 주제는 아니다.

How Earth's Gravitational Pull and Tides Continuously Shape the Moon's Surface
The Negligible Influence of the Moon's Gravity on Earth's Axial Tilt and Seasons
The Relationship Between Ocean Friction and the 24-Hour Rotation Rate of the Earth
The Essential Roles of the Moon in Regulating Earth's Environment and Climate

The tallest man in recorded history was 272 cm tall, but have you ever wondered what ⓐwould happen if humans could grow to enormous sizes like the giant in Jack and the Beanstalk? Unfortunately, the answer to this hypothetical question is that it is impossible due to the scale effect. When the length of an object doubles, its area increases by a factor of four (2×2), and its volume by a factor of eight (2×2×2). These changes can create many problems that would put the giant’s life in danger. One issue is that the giant would not be able to stand properly on his own because of the weight
ⓑpush down on his feet. If a person’s height increased ten times, his weight ⓒwould increase by a factor of 1,000 (10×10×10) because weight changes in proportion to volume. However, the area of the feet supporting his body would only increase by a factor of 100 (10×10). This means that his feet would be under too much pressure to support the increased weight because the mass would have increased ⓓfar more than the area of his feet. In addition, there is an issue of heat emission. Heat is generated in the human body, and it is constantly released from the surface of the skin to prevent heat from ⓔaccumulating in the body. If a person’s height ⓕwere to increase ten times, the amount of heat generated would increase a thousand times in proportion to the body’s volume. However, the surface area of the person’s skin would only increase a hundred times, and as a result, not enough heat ⓖwould release from the body through the skin. This shows that while we may wish to grow as ⓗtall as a giant, we would not be able to survive in that form.
solution: ⓑ push → pushing 문맥상 '발을 짓누르는 무게'라는 의미로 weight를 수식하는 분사 자리이다. weight가 발을 '짓누르는' 능동의 의미이므로 동사원형 push가 아니라 현재분사 pushing이 되어야 한다. ⓖ would release → would be released 문맥상 '열이 방출되다'라는 수동의 의미이다. release는 타동사이므로 목적어 없이 쓰이려면 수동태가 되어야 하므로, would release가 아니라 would be released가 되어야 한다. ⓐ 가정법 과거 조건절 "if humans could grow"에 맞춰 주절의 동사도 조동사 과거형인 would happen이 올바르게 쓰였다. ⓒ 가정법 과거 조건절 "If a person's height increased"에 맞춰 주절의 동사도 조동사 과거형인 would increase가 올바르게 쓰였다. ⓓ 비교급 more를 강조하는 부사 far가 올바르게 쓰였다. ⓔ 'prevent A from -ing' 구문에 맞게 동명사 accumulating이 올바르게 쓰였다. ⓕ 가정법 과거 문장이므로 조건절의 과거동사 were가 올바르게 쓰였다. ⓗ 원급 비교 구문 'as + 형용사 + as'에서 tall이 올바르게 쓰였다.

2개

If a person’s height increased ten times, his weight would increase by a factor of 1,000 (10×10×10) because weight changes in ⓒproportion to volume. However, the area of the feet supporting his body would only increase by a factor of 100 (10×10). This means that his feet would be under too much pressure to
ⓓresist the increased weight because the mass would have increased far more than the area of his feet. In addition, there is an issue of heat emission. Heat is generated in the human body, and it is constantly released from the surface of the skin to prevent heat from ⓔaccumulating in the body. If a person’s height were to increase ten times, the amount of heat generated would increase a thousand times in proportion to the body’s volume. However, the surface area of the person’s skin would only increase a hundred times, and as a result, ⓕsufficient heat would be released from the body through the skin. solution: ⓓ resist → support 문맥상 '발이 늘어난 무게를 지탱하기에는 압력이 너무 크다'는 의미가 되어야 한다. 저항하다(resist)가 아니라 지탱하다(support)로 바꿔야 한다. ⓕ sufficient → insufficient (또는 not enough) 문맥상 피부 표면적이 100배만 증가하여 '충분한 열이 방출되지 못하는' 결과로 이어져야 한다. 충분한(sufficient) 이 아니라 불충분한(insufficient)으로 바꿔야 한다. ⓐ enormous: 거대한 ⓑ hypothetical: 가정의, 가설의 ⓒ proportion: 비례 ⓔ accumulating: 축적되는, 쌓이는 ⓖ survive: 생존하다

body:
다음 글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?
Without the Moon, however, the Earth's rotation would not slow down, resulting in a change in the length of a day. "O, swear not by the moon, the inconstant moon." This is a famous line from Romeo and Juliet. Juliet warns Romeo not to swear his love by the Moon as it may change just as the Moon changes its shape. ( ⓐ ) Although its appearance changes, the Moon is always present in the night sky and plays a crucial role in regulating the length of the day on Earth as well as the Earth's seasons and weather patterns. ( ⓑ ) Then, what would happen if there were no Moon? Without the Moon, our day would no longer be 24 hours. ( ⓒ ) The Moon's gravity causes the Earth's ocean to rise and fall. Since the ocean is moving and the Earth is also spinning, friction occurs between them. ( ⓓ ) This friction leads to a decrease in the rotation rate of the planet. According to some scientists, when the Earth first formed, there was no Moon and a day was only five hours long. ( ⓔ ) This indicates that without the Moon, we would see the Sun rise every five hours.
solution: ④가 정답이다. 주어진 문장은 '달이 없다면 지구의 자전이 느려지지 않아 하루의 길이가 변할 것'이라는 내용으로, ⓓ 앞 문장에서 마찰이 행성의 자전 속도 감소로 이어진다고 설명한 뒤, 주어진 문장이 달이 없을 경우를 대조적으로 제시하고, 이어서 과학자들의 연구 결과(5시간 하루)가 그 근거로 자연스럽게 연결되므로 ⓓ에 들어가는 것이 가장 적절하다. ①이는 달의 외양 변화와 중요한 역할을 소개하는 내용 앞으로, 주어진 문장과 문맥상 연결되지 않는다. ②가는 '달이 없다면?'이라는 화제를 전환하는 의문문 앞으로, 주어진 문장을 이 위치에 넣으면 달의 역할 설명이 나오기 전에 결론이 제시되어 흐름이 어색하다. ③이는 달의 중력으로 바다가 오르내린다는 원인 설명이 시작되기 전으로, 주어진 문장의 역접 흐름이 성립하지 않는다. ⑤가는 5시간 하루라는 과학자들의 주장 뒤로, 주어진 문장이 여기 오면 앞뒤 인과 관계가 역전되어 부자연스럽다.
choices: ⓔ 2회차 실전 모의고사

body:
다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
Oxygen is a vital gas for life, making up 21 percent of the Earth's atmosphere. It is essential for breathing and is also necessary to burn common fuels like wood and oil to generate heat and light. Undoubtedly, it is an indispensable element for organisms on Earth. Then, would it be better to have a higher concentration of oxygen in the atmosphere? What would happen if the oxygen concentration were to double? While more oxygen may seem beneficial, it could have unexpected consequences, especially for insects. Insects, such as bees and dragonflies, do not have lungs and instead take in air through external openings called spiracles. Although insects can survive without lungs, their spiracles are not as efficient as lungs at taking in air.
solution: ① 지문에서 산소는 지구 대기의 21퍼센트를 차지한다고 명시되어 있으므로 일치한다. ② 지문에서 산소는 나무와 기름 같은 연료를 태우는 데 필요하다고 했으므로 일치하지 않는다. ③ 지문에서 꿀벌과 잠자리는 폐가 없고 기문(spiracles)을 통해 공기를 들이마신다고 했으므로 일치하지 않는다. ④ 지문에서 기문은 폐만큼 공기를 효율적으로 흡입하지 못한다고 했으므로 일치하지 않는다. ⑤ 지문에서 더 많은 산소는 이로워 보일 수 있지만 예상치 못한 결과를 초래할 수 있다고 했으므로 일치하지 않는다. 미래엔(김) 4과
choices: Oxygen makes up about 21 percent of the Earth's atmosphere.
Oxygen is not necessary to burn fuels like wood and oil.
Bees and dragonflies breathe through lungs like humans.
Spiracles are more efficient than lungs at taking in air.
A higher concentration of oxygen would only bring benefits.

body:
다음 글을 읽고 대답할 수 없는 질문은?
Additionally, the absence of the Moon would completely change weather patterns on Earth. We experience the beauty of different seasons because the Earth is tilted on its axis. The axis of rotation of the Earth is tilted at an angle of 23.5 degrees, and the Moon's gravity holds the Earth in place by stabilizing the tilt. However, if there were no Moon, the tilt could vary wildly between 0 and 85 degrees. Suppose the Earth were tilted at an angle of 60 degrees. The hemisphere of the Earth facing the Sun would receive much more energy from the sun than the other hemisphere. This could bring about extreme shifts in weather patterns, potentially making summers hotter and winters colder. If this trend continued, the Earth would become uninhabitable.
solution: ④ 달이 얼마나 오랫동안 지구 자전축의 기울기를 안정시켜 왔는지에 대한 기간은 지문에 언급되지 않았으므로 대답할 수 없다. ① 지구가 자전축을 중심으로 기울어져 있기 때문에 다양한 계절을 겪는다는 내용이 명시되어 있으므로 대답할 수 있다. ② 현재 지구 자전축의 기울기가 23.5도라는 내용이 명시되어 있으므로 대답할 수 있다. ③ 달의 중력이 자전축의 기울기를 안정시켜 지구를 고정해 준다는 내용이 명시되어 있으므로 대답할 수 있다. ⑤ 극심한 날씨 변화 추세가 지속되면 지구가 사람이 살 수 없는 곳이 될 것이라는 내용이 명시되어 있으므로 대답할 수 있다.
choices: Why do we experience different seasons on Earth?
At what angle is the Earth's axis currently tilted?
How does the Moon help stabilize the Earth's axial tilt?
How long has the Moon been stabilizing the Earth's tilt?
What would happen to Earth if extreme weather trends continued?

body:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 옳은 것은?
Additionally, the absence of the Moon would completely change weather patterns on Earth. We experience the beauty of different seasons because the Earth is ⓐtilting on its axis. The axis of rotation of the Earth is tilted at an angle of 23.5 degrees, and the Moon's gravity holds the Earth in place by ⓑstabilized the tilt. However, if there were no Moon, the tilt could vary wildly between 0 and 85 degrees. Suppose the Earth ⓒwere tilted at an angle of 60 degrees. The hemisphere of the Earth ⓓfaced the Sun would receive much more energy from the sun than the other hemisphere. This could bring about extreme shifts in weather patterns, potentially ⓔmade summers hotter and winters colder. If this trend continued, the Earth would become uninhabitable.
solution: ③이 정답이다. 'Suppose the Earth were tilted at an angle of 60 degrees.'에서 ⓒwere tilted는 가정법 과거의 수동태 구조로, 'were + 과거분사' 형태가 올바르게 쓰였다. 'Suppose'가 이끄는 절에서 현재 사실에 반하는 가정을 나타낼 때 동사는 가정법 과거(were)를 사용하며, 주어인 'the Earth'가 기울어지는 대상이므로 수동태가 적절하다. ① tilting → tilted 'the Earth is tilted on its axis'에서 지구가 기울어진 상태에 있다는 수동의 의미를 나타내므로 과거분사 tilted가 와야 한다. 현재분사 tilting은 능동·진행의 의미를 나타내므로 문맥상 부적절하다. ② stabilized → stabilizing 'by'는 전치사이므로 뒤에 동명사(-ing형)가 와야 한다. 따라서 과거분사 stabilized가 아닌 동명사 stabilizing으로 써야 한다. ④ faced → facing 'the hemisphere of the Earth facing the Sun'에서 반구가 능동적으로 태양을 향하고 있음을 나타내므로 현재분사 facing이 와야 한다. faced로 쓰면 'The hemisphere of the Earth faced the Sun would receive ...'처럼 동사가 두 개 충돌하는 비문이 된다. ⑤ made → making 'potentially making summers hotter and winters colder'는 앞 절의 결과를 나타내는 분사구문으로, 주절의 주어(This)가 능동적으로 만드는 것이므로 현재분사 making이 와야 한다. 과거분사 made는 수동의 의미를 나타내므로 문맥상 부적절하다.

body:
다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
The tallest man in recorded history was 272 cm tall, but have you ever wondered what would happen if humans could grow to enormous sizes like the giant in Jack and the Beanstalk? Unfortunately, the answer to this hypothetical question is that it is impossible due to the scale effect. When the length of an object doubles, its area increases by a factor of four (2×2), and its volume by a factor of eight (2×2×2). These changes can create many problems that would put the giant's life in danger. One issue is that the giant would not be able to stand properly on his own because of the weight pushing down on his feet. If a person's height increased ten times, his weight would increase by a factor of 1,000 (10×10×10) because weight changes in proportion to volume. However, the area of the feet supporting his body would only increase by a factor of 100 (10×10). This means that his feet would be under too much pressure to support the increased weight because the mass would have increased far more than the area of his feet.
solution: ① 스케일 효과로 인해 인간이 거대한 크기로 성장하는 것은 불가능하다고 설명하므로, 글의 주제로 가장 적절하다. ② 키가 큰 사람들의 건강 관리 방법은 언급되지 않았다. ③ 동화 속 거인의 특징이나 종류는 글의 주제가 아니라, 도입부의 예시로만 사용되었다. ④ 인간의 키 성장을 돕는 요인들은 언급되지 않았다. ⑤ 발의 크기와 체중의 관계는 스케일 효과의 문제점을 설명하기 위한 구체적 사례일 뿐, 글 전체의 주제는 아니다. 미래엔(김) 4과

body:
다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.
Oxygen is a vital gas for life, making up 21 percent of the Earth’s atmosphere. It is essential for breathing and is also necessary to burn common fuels like wood and oil to generate heat and light. Undoubtedly, ⓐit is an indispensable element for organisms on Earth. Then, would it be better to have a higher concentration of oxygen in the atmosphere? What would happen if the oxygen concentration were to double? While more oxygen may seem beneficial, it could have unexpected consequences, especially for insects. Insects, such as bees and dragonflies, do not have lungs and instead take in air through external openings called spiracles. Although insects can survive without lungs,
(A)their spiracles are not as efficient as lungs at taking in air. Therefore, with the current oxygen concentration, insects cannot evolve to be larger than their current size. If they were bigger in size, oxygen would not be able to reach the deepest parts of their bodies. However, if the concentration of oxygen were to double, insects could grow in size as oxygen would be more readily available. This increase in insect size could have a significant influence on the ecological environment, potentially disrupting the food chain. Have you ever heard the expression "I love you to the moon and back"? This expression ⓐconveys a deep extent of love, and uses the great distance between the Earth and the Moon as a metaphor. While this expression is easily understood, there are idioms with a scientific background that may not be so obvious. One example is the phrase "once in a blue moon." Although people may have seen a magnificent full moon brightening the night sky or a tiny crescent ⓑresembling a clipped fingernail, it is highly unlikely that they have seen a blue moon. Surprisingly, this ⓒordinary event does occur. Normally, there is only one full moon in a month. However, every 2.5 years, there can be two full moons in the same month. The second moon is called a "blue moon," and it ⓓoccurs because the Moon completes its cycle of phases in only about 29.5 days. From this rare phenomenon of a blue moon emerged the use of the expression "once in a blue moon." It ⓔdescribes something that happens exceptionally rarely.

body:
다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.
“O, swear not by the moon, the inconstant moon.” This is a famous line from Romeo and Juliet. Juliet warns Romeo not to swear his love by the Moon as it may change just as the Moon changes its shape. Although its appearance changes, the Moon is always present in the night sky and plays a crucial role in regulating the length of the day on Earth as well as the Earth’s seasons and weather patterns. Then, what would happen if there were no Moon? Without the Moon, our day would no longer be 24 hours. The Moon’s gravity causes the Earth’s ocean to rise and fall. Since the ocean is moving and the Earth is also spinning, friction occurs between them. This friction leads to a decrease in the rotation rate of the planet. Without the Moon, (A) _____ , the Earth’s rotation would not slow down, resulting in a change in the length of a day. According to some scientists, when the Earth first formed, there was no Moon and a day was only five hours long. This indicates that without the Moon, we would see the Sun rise every five hours.
(B) _____ , the absence of the Moon would completely change weather patterns on Earth. We experience the beauty of different seasons because the Earth is tilted on its axis. The axis of rotation of the Earth is tilted at an angle of 23.5 degrees, and the Moon’s gravity holds the Earth in place by stabilizing the tilt. However, if there were no Moon, the tilt could vary wildly between 0 and 85 degrees. Suppose the Earth were tilted at an angle of 60 degrees. The hemisphere of the Earth facing the Sun would receive much more energy from the sun than the other hemisphere. This could bring about extreme shifts in weather patterns, potentially making summers hotter and winters colder. If this trend continued, the Earth would become uninhabitable.

위 글 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 가장 적절한 연결어는?
solution: (A) 앞 내용은 달의 인력과 지구 자전의 마찰로 인해 자전 속도가 느려진다는 것이고, 뒤 내용은 달이 없으면 자전 속도가 느려지지 않는다는 대조적 내용이므로 역접의 접속사가 적절하다. (B) 앞 내용은 달의 부재가 하루 길이에 미치는 영향을 서술한 것이고, 뒤 내용은 달의 부재가 기후 패턴까지 완전히 바꾼다는 추가 내용이 이어지므로 첨가의 접속사가 적절하다.
choices: moreover - Nevertheless
therefore - In contrast
however - For instance
however - Additionally
otherwise - Consequently

The tallest man in recorded history was 272 cm tall, but have you ever wondered what would happen if humans could grow to enormous sizes like the giant in Jack and the Beanstalk? Unfortunately, the answer to this hypothetical question is that it is impossible due to the scale effect. When the length of an object doubles, its area increases by a factor of four (2×2), and its volume by a factor of eight (2×2×2). These changes can create many problems that would put the giant’s life in danger. One issue is that the giant would not be able to stand properly on his own because of the weight pushing down on his feet. 만일 어떤 사람의 키가 10배 증가하면, 무게가 용적에 비례하여 변하기 때문에 그의 몸무 게는 1,000배 증가할 것이다. However, the area of the feet supporting his body would only increase by a factor of 100. This means that his feet would be under too much pressure to support the increased weight because the mass would have increased far more than the area of his feet.

2. <보기>의 단어를 모두 한 번씩 사용할 것 (단, 필요시 형태를 변형할 것)
3. 필요시 단어를 추가할 것
보기 volume / change / weight / increase / person / height / weight / proportion / increase / times / factor / 1 / 000 / because
→
answer: If a person’s height increased ten times, his weight would increase by a factor of 1,000 because weight changes in proportion to volume.

'~배로'라는 의미는 by a factor of 뒤에 배수 1,000을 붙여 by a factor of 1,000으로 쓴다. 'in proportion to+명사'는 '~에 비례하여'라는 의미로 뒤에 명사 volume을 붙여 in proportion to volume으로 쓴다. 미래엔(김) 4과

body:
다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.
The tallest man in recorded history was 272 cm tall, but have you ever wondered what would happen if humans could grow to enormous sizes like the giant in Jack and the Beanstalk? Unfortunately, the answer to this hypothetical question is that it is impossible due to the scale effect. When the length of an object doubles, its area increases by a factor of four (2×2), and its volume by a factor of eight (2×2×2). These changes can create many problems that would put the giant’s life in danger. One issue is that the giant would not be able to stand properly on his own because of the weight pushing down on his feet. If a person’s height increased ten times, his weight would increase by a factor of 1,000 (10×10×10) because weight changes in proportion to volume. However, the area of the feet supporting his body would only increase by a factor of 100 (10×10). This means that his feet would be under too much pressure to support the increased weight because _____ . In addition, there is an issue of heat emission. Heat is generated in the human body, and it is constantly released from the surface of the skin to prevent heat from accumulating in the body. If a person’s height were to increase ten times, the amount of heat generated would increase a thousand times in proportion to the body’s volume. However, the surface area of the person’s skin would only increase a hundred times, and as a result, not enough heat would be released from the body through the skin. This shows that while we may wish to grow as tall as a giant, we would not be able to survive in that form.

위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
solution: ③ 지문에서는 발의 면적이 100배 증가하는 것에 비해 체중은 1,000배 증가하여 발이 받는 압력이 너무 커진다고 설명하고 있다. 즉, 늘어난 체중을 안정적으로 견뎌낼 수 없다고 했으므로 선택지는 지문의 내용과 일치하지 않는다. ① 물체의 길이가 2배가 될 때 표면적은 4배, 부피는 8배가 된다는 내용은 지문 초반부와 일치한다. ② 체중이 부피에 비례하여 키가 10배일 때 체중은 1,000배가 된다는 내용은 지문 중반부와 일치한다. ④ 체내 발생 열이 몸속에 축적되는 것을 막기 위해 피부로 배출된다는 내용은 지문 후반부와 일치한다. ⑤ 키가 10배로 커지면 피부 표면적이 불충분해 생존하기 어렵다는 마지막 문장의 내용과 일치한다.
choices: 물체의 길이가 2배가 되면 표면적은 4배, 부피는 8배로 증 가한다.
사람의 체중은 부피에 비례하여 증가하므로 키가 10배가 되 면 체중은 1,000배가 된다.
거인의 발 면적은 키가 10배 늘어날 때 100배 넓어져 늘어 난 체중을 안정적으로 견뎌낼 수 있다.
체내에서 발생한 열은 몸속에 축적되는 것을 방지하기 위해 피부를 통해 계속 배출된다.
키가 10배로 커지면 발생 열량에 비해 피부 표면적이 충분 히 넓어지지 않아 생존하기 어렵다.

body:
다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
“O, swear not by the moon, the inconstant moon.” This is a famous line from Romeo and Juliet. Juliet warns Romeo not to swear his love by the Moon as it may change just as the Moon changes its shape. Although its appearance changes, the Moon is always present in the night sky and plays a crucial role in regulating the length of the day on Earth as well as the Earth’s seasons and weather patterns. Then, what would happen if there were no Moon? Without the Moon, our day would no longer be 24 hours. The Moon’s gravity causes the Earth’s ocean to rise and fall. Since the ocean is moving and the Earth is also spinning, friction occurs between them. This friction leads to a decrease in the rotation rate of the planet. Without the Moon, however, the Earth’s rotation would not slow down, resulting in a change in the length of a day. According to some scientists, when the Earth first formed, there was no Moon and a day was only five hours long. This indicates that without the Moon, we would see the Sun rise every five hours. Additionally, the absence of the Moon would completely change weather patterns on Earth. We experience the beauty of different seasons because the Earth is tilted on its axis. The axis of rotation of the Earth is tilted at an angle of 23.5 degrees, and the Moon’s gravity holds the Earth in place by stabilizing the tilt. 다음 글의 내용을 아래와 같이 한 문장으로 요약하고자 한 다. 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말을 지문에서 찾아 각각 쓰시 오. (단, 필요시 어형 변화 가능)
“O, swear not by the moon, the inconstant moon.” This is a famous line from Romeo and Juliet. Juliet warns Romeo not to swear his love by the Moon as it may change just as the Moon changes its shape. Although its appearance changes, the Moon is always present in the night sky and plays a crucial role in regulating the length of the day on Earth as well as the Earth’s seasons and weather patterns. Then, what would happen if there were no Moon? Without the Moon, our day would no longer be 24 hours. The Moon’s gravity causes the Earth’s ocean to rise and fall. Since the ocean is moving and the Earth is also spinning, friction occurs between them. This friction leads to a decrease in the rotation rate of the planet. Without the Moon, however, the Earth’s rotation would not slow down, resulting in a change in the length of a day. According to some scientists, when the Earth first formed, there was no Moon and a day was only five hours long. This indicates that without the Moon, we would see the Sun rise every five hours. Additionally, the absence of the Moon would completely change weather patterns on Earth. We experience the beauty of different seasons because the Earth is tilted on its axis. The axis of rotation of the Earth is tilted at an angle of 23.5 degrees, and the Moon’s gravity holds the Earth in place by stabilizing the tilt. However, if there were no Moon, the tilt could vary wildly between 0 and 85 degrees. Suppose the Earth were tilted at an angle of 60 degrees. The hemisphere of the Earth facing the Sun would receive much more energy from the sun than the other hemisphere. This could bring about extreme shifts in weather patterns, potentially making summers hotter and winters colder. If this trend continued, the Earth would become uninhabitable. The Moon's gravity keeps both the Earth's (A) speed and its axial tilt (B) _____ , so losing the Moon would trigger extreme changes in day length and climate.
(A) _____ (B) _____ 3회차 실전 모의고사
solution: (A) 지문에서 달의 중력이 없으면 지구의 자전(rotation) 속도가 느려지지 않아 하루 길이가 달라진다고 했으므로, 지구가 유지하는 속도는 자전 속도, 즉 rotation speed이다. (B) 지문에서 달의 중력이 지구의 자전축 기울기를 "stabilizing"(안정시키는)한다고 했으므로, 동사 stabilize를 형용사 stable로 형태를 변형하여 axial tilt stable(자전축 기울기를 안정적으로)로 쓴다. 미래엔(김) 4과

“O, swear not by the moon, the ⓐconstant moon.” This is a famous line from Romeo and Juliet. Juliet warns Romeo not to swear his love by the Moon as it may change just as the Moon changes its shape. Although its appearance changes, the Moon is always ⓑpresent in the night sky and plays a crucial role in regulating the length of the day on Earth as well as the Earth’s seasons and weather patterns. Then, what would happen if there were no Moon? Without the Moon, our day would no longer be 24 hours. The Moon’s gravity causes the Earth’s ocean to rise and fall. Since the ocean is moving and the Earth is also spinning, friction occurs between them. This ⓒfriction leads to a decrease in the rotation rate of the planet. Without the Moon, however, the Earth’s rotation would not slow down, resulting in a change in the ⓓlength of a day. According to some scientists, when the Earth first formed, there was no Moon and a day was only five hours long. This indicates that without the Moon, we would see the Sun rise every five hours. Additionally, the ⓔabundance of the Moon would completely change weather patterns on Earth. We experience the beauty of different seasons because the Earth is tilted on its axis. The axis of rotation of the Earth is ⓕtilted at an angle of 23.5 degrees, and the Moon’s gravity holds the Earth in place by stabilizing the tilt. However, if there were no Moon, the tilt could ⓖstabilize wildly between 0 and 85 degrees. Suppose the Earth were tilted at an angle of 60 degrees. The hemisphere of the Earth facing the Sun would receive much more energy from the sun than the other hemisphere. This could bring about extreme shifts in weather patterns, potentially making summers hotter and winters colder. If this trend continued, the Earth would become ⓗinhabitable.
solution: ⓐ constant → inconstant 지문의 흐름상 줄리엣이 달을 두고 맹세하지 말라고 경고하는 이유는, 달이 모양을 바꾸듯 사랑도 변할 수 있기 때문이다. 즉 달의 변덕스러운 속성을 나타내는 inconstant가 되어야 한다. ⓔ abundance → absence 지문의 흐름상 달이 없을 때 날씨 패턴이 완전히 바뀐다는 내용이 이어져야 한다. 따라서 풍부함(abundance)이 아니라 부재(absence)로 바꿔야 한다. ⓖ stabilize → vary 지문의 흐름상 달이 없으면 자전축 기울기가 0도에서 85도 사이로 크게 요동칠 수 있다는 내용이 되어야 한다. 안정화되다(stabilize)가 아니라 변동하다(vary)로 바꿔야 한다. ⓗ inhabitable → uninhabitable 지문의 흐름상 극단적인 기후 변화가 지속되면 지구가 살기 어려운 곳이 된다는 부정적 결론이 되어야 한다. 거주 가능한 (inhabitable)이 아니라 거주 불가능한(uninhabitable) 으로 바꿔야 한다. ⓑ present: 존재하는, 있는 ⓒ friction: 마찰 ⓓ length: 길이 ⓕ tilted: 기울어진

body:
다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.
Oxygen is a vital gas for life, making up 21 percent of the Earth’s atmosphere. It is essential for breathing and is also necessary to burn common fuels like wood and oil to generate heat and light. Undoubtedly, it is an indispensable element for organisms on Earth. Then, would it be better to have a higher concentration of oxygen in the atmosphere? What would happen if the oxygen concentration were to double? While more oxygen may seem beneficial, it could have unexpected consequences, especially for insects. Insects, such as bees and dragonflies, do not have lungs and instead take in air through external openings called spiracles. Although insects can survive without lungs, their spiracles are not as efficient as lungs at taking in air. Therefore, with the current oxygen concentration, insects cannot evolve to be larger than their current size. If they were bigger in size, oxygen would not be able to reach the deepest parts of their bodies. However, if the concentration of oxygen were to double, insects could grow in size as oxygen would be more readily available. This increase in insect size could _____ , potentially disrupting the food chain. Dragonflies, for example, may become as large as eagles, altering the balance of predators and prey in the ecosystem. Fortunately, you wouldn’t need to worry about giant insects chasing after you if this were to occur. If the oxygen concentration were to double, you would be able to run faster than you can right now. Considering that oxygen is used to break down energy so that muscles can use it, the increase in oxygen would help to use energy more efficiently and improve our capability for physical exercise. This leads us to expect that athletes would set new world records at the Olympics.

위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
solution: ⑤ 지문 후반부에서는 산소 농도가 2배가 되면 에너지를 더 효율적으로 사용하여 신체 운동 능력을 향상시킬 것이라고 명시하고 있다. 따라서 에너지 분해 효율이 떨어져 운동 능력에 제약을 준다고 설명한 선택지는 지문의 내용과 정반대이다. ① 산소가 대기의 21%를 차지하며 연료를 태워 열과 빛을 내는 데 필수적이라는 내용은 지문 초반부와 일치한다. ② 곤충이 폐 대신 기문을 통해 공기를 흡수하지만 폐만큼 효율적이지 않다는 내용은 지문 중반부와 일치한다. ③ 산소 농도가 2배가 되면 산소가 쉽게 전달되어 곤충의 크기가 커질 수 있다는 내용은 지문 중반부와 일치한다. ④ 곤충의 대형화로 인해 생태계의 포식자와 피식자 간 균형이 변화될 수 있다는 내용은 지문 중후반부와 일치한다.
choices: 산소는 지구 대기의 21%를 차지하며, 목재나 석유 같은 연료 를 태워 열과 빛을 발생하는 데 필수적이다.
벌이나 잠자리 같은 곤충은 폐 대신 기문(spiracles)을 통해 공기를 흡수하지만, 이는 폐만큼 효율적이지 않다.
산소 농도가 2배로 증가하면 곤충 몸속 깊은 곳까지 산소가 쉽게 전달되어 곤충의 크기가 커질 수 있다.
대기 중 산소 농도가 증가하면 곤충의 대형화로 인해 생태계 의 포식자와 피식자 간 균형이 변화될 수 있다.
대기 중 산소 농도가 2배가 되면 근육의 에너지 분해 효율이 떨어져 인간의 운동 능력 확장에 제약을 주게 된다.

solution: ⓒ will happen → would happen 가정법 과거 문장이므로 주절의 동사는 조동사의 과거형을 써야 한다. 따라서 will happen이 아니라 would happen이 되어야 한다. ⓓ rise → to rise causes는 목적격보어로 to부정사를 취하므로 rise가 아니라 to rise가 되어야 한다. ⓔ resulted → resulting 앞 절의 내용을 부가적으로 설명하는 분사구문 자리이며, the Earth's rotation이 변화를 '초래하는' 능동의 의미이므로 과거형 resulted가 아니라 현재분사 resulting이 되어야 한다. ⓖ other → the other 문맥상 지구를 태양을 향한 반구와 그 반대편 반구, 즉 정해진 둘로 나누고 있으므로, 나머지 하나를 가리킬 때는 the other로 써야 한다. ⓗ has continued → continued 주절이 would become인 가정법 과거 문장이므로, 현재완료 has continued가 아니라 동사의 과거형인 continued가 되어야 한다. ⓐ to부정사의 부정은 not을 to부정사 앞에 쓴다. ⓑ 의미상 '~뿐만 아니라'라는 뜻의 상관접속사 as well as가 올바르게 쓰였다. ⓕ '제자리에'라는 뜻의 관용 표현으로 in place가 올바르게 쓰였다.

The hemisphere of the Earth facing the Sun would receive much more energy from the sun than
ⓖother hemisphere. This could bring about extreme shifts in weather patterns, potentially making summers hotter and winters colder. If this trend ⓗhas continued, the Earth would become uninhabitable.

Exploring Idioms: From Love to Rare Occurrences Have you ever heard the expression “I love you to the moon and back”? This expression conveys a deep extent of love, and uses the great distance between the Earth and the Moon as a metaphor. While this expression is easily understood, there are idioms with a scientific background that may not be so obvious. One example is the phrase “once in a blue moon.” Although people may have seen a magnificent full moon brightening the night sky or a tiny crescent resembling a clipped fingernail, it is highly unlikely that they have seen a blue moon. Surprisingly, this extraordinary event does occur. Normally, there is only one full moon in a month. However, every 2.5 years, there can be two full moons in the same month. The second moon is called a “blue moon,” and it occurs because the Moon completes its cycle of phases in only about 29.5 days. From this rare phenomenon of a blue moon emerged the use of the expression “once in a blue moon.” It describes something that happens exceptionally rarely.
solution: ① 오답: ‘once in a blue moon’은 매우 드물게 일어나는 일을 뜻하는 표현이다. 매달 규칙적으로 발생하는 일을 의미한다는 내용은 지문과 반대된다. ② 오답: ‘I love you to the moon and back’은 지구와 달 사이의 먼 거리를 사랑의 깊이에 비유한 표현이다. 달의 위상 변화 주기에서 유래했다는 내용은 제시되지 않았다. ③ 오답: 지문에서 ‘blue moon’은 같은 달에 두 번째로 뜨는 보름달을 가리킨다. 달이 실제로 파란색으로 보이기 때문에 그렇게 불리는 것은 아니다. ④ 정답: 달의 위상 변화 주기가 약 29.5일이기 때문에, 드물게 하나의 달력상 한 달 안에 보름달이 두 번 나타날 수 있다. 따라서 비교적 짧은 달의 주기가 한 달에 두 번의 보름달이 발생할 가능성을 만든다고 추론할 수 있으므로 ④가 가장 적절하다. ⑤ 오답: 지문에서는 과학적 배경을 가진 일부 관용 표현은 그 의미나 유래가 쉽게 드러나지 않을 수 있다고 설명한다. 따라서 과학적 관용 표현이 비유적 표현보다 일반적으로 이해하기 쉽다는 내용은 지문과 일치하지 않는다.
choices: The expression “once in a blue moon” refers to an event that happens regularly every month.
The phrase “I love you to the moon and back” originated from the Moon’s cycle of phases.
A blue moon is called so because the Moon actually appears blue during its second full moon.
The relatively short lunar cycle makes it possible for two full moons to occur within a single calendar month on rare occasions.
Scientific idioms are generally easier to understand than expressions based on metaphor. 3회차 실전 모의고사

다음 글의 내용을 한 문장으로 요약하고자 한다. 빈칸 (A),
(B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
"O, swear not by the moon, the inconstant moon." This is a famous line from Romeo and Juliet. Juliet warns Romeo not to swear his love by the Moon as it may change just as the Moon changes its shape. Although its appearance changes, the Moon is always present in the night sky and plays a crucial role in regulating the length of the day on Earth as well as the Earth's seasons and weather patterns. Then, what would happen if there were no Moon? Without the Moon, our day would no longer be 24 hours. The Moon's gravity causes the Earth's ocean to rise and fall. Since the ocean is moving and the Earth is also spinning, friction occurs between them. This friction leads to a decrease in the rotation rate of the planet. Without the Moon, however, the Earth's rotation would not slow down, resulting in a change in the length of a day. According to some scientists, when the Earth first formed, there was no Moon and a day was only five hours long. This indicates that without the Moon, we would see the Sun rise every five hours. The Moon has a(n) (A) _____ influence on Earth by using its gravity to (B) _____ the planet's rotation, which determines the length of a day.
solution: (A) 달은 지구의 자전 속도를 조절하고 하루의 길이, 계절, 날씨 패턴 등에 결정적인 역할을 한다는 내용이 본문 전체에 걸쳐 서술되어 있으므로 'significant(중요한/상당한)'이 가장 적절하다. (B) 달의 중력이 해양과 지구 사이의 마찰을 일으켜 지구의 자전 속도를 감소시킨다고 했으므로 'slow down(늦추다)'이 가장 적절하다. 따라서 ③이 정답이다.

"O, swear not by the moon, the inconstant moon." This is a famous line from Romeo and Juliet. Juliet warns Romeo not to swear his love by the Moon as it may change just as the Moon changes its shape. ⓐDespite its appearance changes, the Moon is always present in the night sky and plays a crucial role in regulating the length of the day on Earth as well as the Earth's seasons and weather patterns. Then, what would happen if
ⓑthere was no Moon? Without the Moon, our day would no longer be 24 hours. The Moon's gravity causes the Earth's ocean ⓒto rising and fall. Since the ocean is moving and the Earth is also spinning, friction occurs between them. This friction leads to a decrease in the rotation rate of the planet. Without the Moon, however, the Earth's rotation would not slow down, ⓓresulted in a change in the length of a day. According to some scientists, when the Earth first formed, there was no Moon and a day was only five hours long. This indicates that without the Moon, we would see the Sun ⓔrise every five hours.
solution: ⑤ 지각동사 see는 「see + 목적어 + 동사원형」 구조를 취하므로, 목적격 보어 자리에 동사원형 rise가 올바르게 쓰였다. 따라서 ⑤가 정답이다. ① Despite its → Although its 'Despite'는 전치사로, 뒤에 명사(구)만 올 수 있다. 그런데 뒤에 「its appearance changes 」라는 절(주어+동사)이 이어지므로, 접속사 Although로 고쳐야 한다. ② there was → there were 「if there were no Moon」은 현재 사실에 반대되는 가정을 나타내는 가정법 과거 구문이다. 가정법 과거에서는 be동사를 주어의 수와 관계없이 were로 써야 하므로, was를 were로 고쳐야 한다. ③ to rising → to rise 「cause + 목적어 + to-부정사」는 목적격 보어로 to-부정사를 취하는 구문이다. 따라서 rising을 동사원형 rise로 고쳐 to rise로 써야 한다. ④ resulted in → resulting in 'Without the Moon, however, the Earth's rotation would not slow down'이라는 주절에 이어지는 분사구문으로, 앞 내용의 결과를 나타낸다. 문장의 술어동사가 이미 있으므로 과거동사 resulted가 아닌 현재분사 resulting을 써야 한다.

body:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 옳은 것은?
The tallest man in recorded history was 272 cm tall, but have you ever wondered ⓐthat would happen if humans could grow to enormous sizes like the giant in Jack and the Beanstalk? Unfortunately, the answer to this hypothetical question is that it is impossible due to the scale effect. When the length of an object ⓑdouble, its area increases by a factor of four (2×2), and its volume by a factor of eight (2×2×2). These changes can create many problems ⓒwho would put the giant's life in danger. One issue is that the giant would not be able to stand ⓓproper on his own because of the weight pushing down on his feet. If a person's height increased ten times, his weight would increase by a factor of 1,000 (10×10×10) because weight changes in proportion to volume. However, the area of the feet ⓔsupporting his body would only increase by a factor of 100 (10×10). This means that his feet would be under too much pressure to support the increased weight because the mass would have increased far more than the area of his feet.
solution: ⑤가 정답이다. ⓔ supporting: 수식받는 명사 'the feet'와 현재분사가 '몸을 지탱하는 발'이라는 능동 관계를 이루므로, 'the feet'를 후행 수식하는 능동 형태의 현재분사 supporting이 올바르게 쓰였다. ① that would → what would 'wondered' 뒤에 오는 간접의문문에서는 의문사 'what'이 필요하다. 접속사 'that'은 간접의문문을 이끌 수 없으며, 'what would happen'처럼 의문사가 절의 주어 역할을 해야 한다. 따라서 'that would'를 'what would'로 고쳐야 한다. ② double → doubles 종속절 'When the length of an object doubles'에서 주어는 단수 명사 'the length'이므로, 동사도 단수형 'doubles'를 써야 한다. 'double'은 복수 주어에 쓰이는 형태이므로 틀렸다. ③ who would → that would (또는 which would) 선행사 'many problems'는 사물이므로, 사람을 가리키는 관계대명사 'who'를 쓸 수 없다. 사물 선행사에는 'that' 또는 'which'를 써야 한다. ④ proper → properly 동사 'stand'를 수식하려면 부사가 필요하다. 형용사 'proper'는 동사를 수식할 수 없으므로, 부사형 'properly'로 고쳐야 한다.

다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.
The tallest man in recorded history was 272 cm tall, but have you ever wondered what would happen if humans could grow to enormous sizes like the giant in Jack and the Beanstalk? Unfortunately, the answer to this hypothetical question is that it is impossible due to the scale effect. When the length of an object doubles, its area increases by a factor of four (2×2), and its volume by a factor of eight (2×2×2). These changes can create many problems that would put the giant’s life in danger. One issue is that the giant would not be able to stand properly on his own because of the weight pushing down on his feet. If a person’s height increased ten times, his weight would increase by a factor of 1,000 (10×10×10) because weight changes in proportion to volume. (A) _____ , the area of the feet supporting his body would only increase by a factor of 100 (10×10). This means that his feet would be under too much pressure to support the increased weight because the mass would have increased far more than the area of his feet.
(B) _____ , there is an issue of heat emission. Heat is generated in the human body, and it is constantly released from the surface of the skin to prevent heat from accumulating in the body. If a person’s height were to increase ten times, the amount of heat generated would increase a thousand times in proportion to the body’s volume. (C) _____ , the surface area of the person’s skin would only increase a hundred times, and as a result, not enough heat would be released from the body through the skin. This shows that while we may wish to grow as tall as a giant, we would not be able to survive in that form.

윗글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
solution: ① 몸이 커질 때 길이·면적·부피가 서로 다른 비율로 증가하는 스케일 효과로 인해, 거인은 자기 몸을 지탱하지 못하고 체온도 제대로 방출하지 못해 생존이 불가능하다는 것이 글 전체의 핵심 주제이다. ② 몸집이 작은 것이 진화적으로 유리하다는 내용은 이 지문에서 다루지 않았다. ③ 길이·면적·부피 사이의 수학적 관계는 글의 결론을 뒷받침하는 근거로 쓰였을 뿐, 글이 전달하고자 하는 최종 주제는 아니다. ④ 인체 표면적을 기준으로 열 발산을 계산하는 방법은 이 지문에서 다루지 않은 내용이다. ⑤ 동화 속 거인 이야기의 역사적 기원과 과학적 근거는 이 지문에서 다루는 내용이 아니다. 미래엔(김) 4과

evolutionary advantages of maintaining a smaller human body size
mathematical relationships between length, surface area, and volume
methods of calculating heat emission based on human body surface area
the historical origin and scientific basis of giant stories in fairy tales

body:
다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?
Additionally, the absence of the Moon would completely change weather patterns on Earth. We experience the beauty of different seasons because the Earth is tilted on its axis. The axis of rotation of the Earth is tilted at an angle of 23.5 degrees, and the Moon's gravity holds the Earth in place by stabilizing the tilt. However, if there were no Moon, the tilt could vary wildly between 0 and 85 degrees. Suppose the Earth were tilted at an angle of 60 degrees. The hemisphere of the Earth facing the Sun would receive much more energy from the sun than the other hemisphere. This could bring about extreme shifts in weather patterns, potentially making summers hotter and winters colder. If this trend continued, the Earth would become uninhabitable.
solution: ①이 정답이다. 달이 없다면 지구의 기울기가 크게 변해 극단적인 기상 변화가 일어나고 결국 지구가 거주 불가능해진다는 내용이므로, 글의 제목으로 가장 적절하다. ② 지구 축의 기울기가 계절을 만든다는 내용은 달의 중력 역할을 설명하기 위한 배경 진술일 뿐, 글 전체의 주제를 담지 못한다. ③ 달의 중력의 역사는 본문에서 언급되지 않았다. ④ 매년 여름이 더워지는 이유는 본문에서 언급되지 않았으며, 글은 달이 없을 경우의 가상 상황을 다룬다. ⑤ 지구의 여러 반구에 대한 내용은 달이 없을 때의 결과를 설명하기 위한 사례일 뿐, 글의 제목으로는 적절하지 않다.

body:
밑줄 친 우리말 문장을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
"O, swear not by the moon, the inconstant moon." This is a famous line from Romeo and Juliet. Juliet warns Romeo not to swear his love by the Moon as it may change just as the Moon changes its shape. Although its appearance changes, the Moon is always present in the night sky and plays a crucial role in regulating the length of the day on Earth as well as the Earth's seasons and weather patterns. Then, what would happen if there were no Moon? Without the Moon, our day would no longer be 24 hours. The Moon's gravity causes the Earth's ocean to rise and fall. Since the ocean is moving and the Earth is also spinning, friction occurs between them. This friction leads to a decrease in the rotation rate of the planet. Without the Moon, however, the Earth's rotation would not slow down, resulting in a change in the length of a day. According to some scientists, when the Earth first formed, there was no Moon and a day was only five hours long. 이것은 달이 없다면, 우리가 매 다섯 시 간마다 태양이 뜨는 것을 보게 될 것임을 나타낸다.
조건 1. 명사절을 이끄는 접속사 that을 사용할 것
2. (indicate, Moon, we, the Sun, every five hour, see)를 모두 포함할 것
3. 필요 시 어형을 변형할 것
→
answer: This indicates that without the Moon, we would see the Sun rise every five hours.
solution: 이것은 ~를 나타낸다'라는 의미를 만들기 위해 주어 This와 indicate의 3인칭 단수형 indicates를 쓴다. 이어서 명사절 접속사 that을 사용하여 목적어절을 이끈다. that절 내부에는 가정의 의미를 담은 전치사구 without the Moon을 쓴다. 주절은 we would see로 시작하며, see가 지각동사이므로 목적어 the Sun 뒤에 목적격 보어로 동사원형 rise를 쓴다. every five hour는 복수형 every five hours로 변형하여 문장을 완성한다.

다음 글의 내용으로 추론할 수 없는 것은?
The tallest man in recorded history was 272 cm tall, but have you ever wondered what would happen if humans could grow to enormous sizes like the giant in Jack and the Beanstalk? Unfortunately, the answer to this hypothetical question is that it is impossible due to the scale effect. When the length of an object doubles, its area increases by a factor of four (2×2), and its volume by a factor of eight (2×2×2). These changes can create many problems that would put the giant's life in danger. One issue is that the giant would not be able to stand properly on his own because of the weight pushing down on his feet. If a person's height increased ten times, his weight would increase by a factor of 1,000 (10×10×10) because weight changes in proportion to volume. However, the area of the feet supporting his body would only increase by a factor of 100 (10×10). This means that his feet would be under too much pressure to support the increased weight because the mass would have increased far more than the area of his feet.
solution: ③ 지문에는 거대 인간의 발이 늘어난 체중을 지탱하기 어렵다고 했을 뿐, 특수 신발이나 보조 장비에 대한 언급은 전혀 없다. 따라서 특별히 설계된 신발이 필요하다는 내용은 추론할 수 없다. ① 스케일 효과 때문에 인간이 거대한 크기로 성장하는 것은 불가능하다고 직접 서술되어 있으므로 추론할 수 있다. ② 크기 변화가 거인의 생명을 위협하는 '많은 문제들(many problems)'을 만들어 낼 것이라고 했으므로, 한 가지 이상의 문제가 있다는 것을 추론할 수 있다. ④ 길이가 두 배가 되면 부피는 8배, 면적은 4배 증가한다고 했으므로 부피가 면적보다 훨씬 빠르게 증가함을 추론할 수 있다. ⑤ 키가 10배 커지면 체중은 1,000배, 발바닥 면적은 100배만 증가하므로 발에 가해지는 압력이 일반인보다 훨씬 크다는 것을 추론할 수 있다.

Have you ever heard the expression “I love you to the moon and back”? This expression conveys a deep extent of love, and uses the great distance between the Earth and the Moon as a metaphor. While this expression is easily understood, there are idioms with a scientific background that may not be so (A)[obvious / subtle]. One example is the phrase “once in a blue moon.” Although people may have seen a magnificent full moon brightening the night sky or a tiny crescent resembling a clipped fingernail, it is highly unlikely that they have seen a blue moon. Surprisingly, this (B)[unusual / ordinary] event does occur. Normally, there is only one full moon in a month. However, every 2.5 years, there can be two full moons in the same month. The second moon is called a “blue moon,” and it occurs because the Moon completes its cycle of phases in only about 29.5 days. From this rare phenomenon of a blue moon emerged the use of the expression “once in a blue moon.” It describes something that happens exceptionally (C)[rarely / regularly].

윗글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C) 안에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임으로 가장 적절한 것은?
solution: (A) 뒤이어 "once in a blue moon"이라는 구체적 예시가 이어지며 그 과학적 배경을 설명하는 흐름이므로, 관용구의 과학적 배경이 명백하지 않을 수 있다는 의미에서 obvious(명백한)가 적절하다. (B) 앞 문장에서 블루문을 실제로 볼 가능성은 매우 낮다고 했는데, 그럼에도 "Surprisingly"로 반전이 시작되므로, 블루문이 실제로 일어나는 일은 평범한 사건이 아니라 흔치 않은 사건이라는 의미에서 unusual(흔치 않은, 이례적인)이 적절하다. (C) "once in a blue moon"이라는 표현은 예외적으로 드물게 일어나는 일을 묘사하므로, rarely(드물게)가 적절하다.

solution: if절에 과거시제(traveled)가 쓰인 가정법 과거 문장이므로 주절에는 would가 와야 한다. 따라서 will을 would로 고쳐야 한다.

body:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?
We serve customers more effectively when we are cheerful. For example, staff members who are cheerful before greeting a customer show almost three times (A)[much / more] patience and attentiveness than staff members in a bad mood. Salespeople who are friendly close deals (B)[very / a lot] quicker than those who are rude. It turns out (C)[what / that] our attitudes are actually shaped to perform at their finest not when we feel indifferent or even neutral, but when we feel cheerful.
solution: (A)는 뒤에 'than'을 사용한 비교 구문이 이어지므로 비교급 more가 와야 한다. much는 비교급 형태가 아니므로 적절하지 않다. (B)는 비교급 quicker를 수식하는 자리로, 비교급을 강조할 때는 a lot을 쓴다. very는 비교급을 직접 수식할 수 없으므로 쓸 수 없다. (C)는 동사구 turn out 뒤에 완전한 문장(주어+동사+보어)이 이어지므로 명사절 접속사 that이 와야 한다. what은 불완전한 문장을 이끌므로 적절하지 않다. 따라서 정답은 ① more - a lot - that이다.
choices: more - a lot - that
much - very - what
more - very - what
more - a lot - what
much - a lot - that

body:
우리말과 같도록 괄호 안의 말을 활용하여 문장을 완성하시오.
이 건물은 저 건물보다 두 배 높다. (twice, tall, that building)
→This building is _____ .
→This building is _____ .
answer: two times as tall as that building, two times taller than that building
solution: 'two times as + 형용사 원급 + as'는 ‘~보다 두 배 ~하다’ 라는 배수 비교 표현이다. 따라서 'two times as tall as that building'이 알맞다. 또한 '배수사 + 비교급 + than'의 형태로도 배수 비교를 나타낼 수 있으므로 'two times taller than that building'도 가능하다. 따라서 두 표현 모두 ‘이 건물은 저 건물보다 두 배 높다’라는 뜻을 나타낸다.

body:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 순서대로 짝지어진 것을 고르시오.
• The Colorado River runs _____ than most rivers in the region.
• She is the _____ student in the debate club.
solution: 실제 거리의 비교이므로 farther than이 알맞다. curious의 최상급은 the most curious이다.
choices: far - more curious
far - most curious
farther - most curious
farther - curiousest
further - more curious

body:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 순서대로 짝지어진 것을 고르시오.
• A falcon can dive three times _____ as an eagle.
• It took _____ less time than expected to complete the survey.
solution: three times as fast as는 ‘~보다 세 배 빠르게’라는 배수 비교 표현이므로 첫 번째 빈칸에는 as fast가 알맞다. 두 번째 문장에서는 비교급 less를 강조하는 부사 even을 써서 even less time than expected로 나타낼 수 있으므로 even이 알맞다.
choices: fast - very
faster than - by far
as fast - even
as fast - by far
faster than - even

body:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것을 고르시오.
Reducing traffic noise in cities is ⓐas not easy to achieve as improving air quality, but both goals are equally important for public health. Many city planners rely on electric vehicles to lower emissions, reduce noise levels, and ⓑcreate quieter streets for residents. However, this transition ⓒis becoming more and more essential as pollution levels reach all-time highs due to industrial growth, rising temperatures, and population increases. For example, cities that adopted electric buses saw pollution levels drop to levels that are approximately ⓓ35 percent lower than before. Because of this, residents in these cities are ⓔmore likely to enjoy cleaner air, and this is improving public health overall.
solution: ⓐ as not easy to achieve as → not as easy to achieve as 원급 비교의 부정 표현은 not as + 원급 + as의 어순을 쓰므로 as not easy to achieve as는 not as easy to achieve as로 고쳐야 한다. ⓑ to lower emissions, reduce noise levels, and create quieter streets는 동사원형이 병렬 구조를 이루므로 옳다. ⓒ 주어 this transition이 단수이므로 단수 동사 is가 알맞다. ⓓ 35 percent lower than before는 ‘이전보다 35% 더 낮은’이라는 뜻의 올바른 비교급 표현이다. ⓔ more + 원급 형용사의 비교급 표현이므로 more likely는 옳다.
choices: ⓔ 교과서 문법 정복 실전 학습

body:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것을 고르시오.
Many teenagers rely on their smartphones to check messages, browse social media, and
ⓐstay connected with friends before bed. However, this habit ⓑis becoming more and more common among students of all ages due to constant notifications, streaming apps, and social pressure. For instance, teens who use phones right before sleeping show *melatonin levels that are approximately ⓒ40 percent lower than those of teens who avoid screens. Because of this, these students are ⓓless likely to fall asleep quickly, and their overall sleep quality declines. This blue light exposure is ⓔas not easy to reduce as other habits like caffeine intake, but it is just as damaging to long-term health. *melatonin 멜라토닌(수면을 유도하는 호르몬)
solution: ⓔ as not easy to reduce as → not as easy to reduce as 원급 비교의 부정 표현은 not as + 원급 + as의 어순을 쓰므로 as not easy to reduce as는 not as easy to reduce as로 고쳐야 한다. ⓐ to check messages, browse social media, and stay connected with friends는 동사원형이 병렬 구조를 이루므로 옳다. ⓑ 주어 this habit이 단수이므로 단수 동사 is가 알맞다. ⓒ 40 percent lower than those of teens who avoid screens는 비교 대상이 일치하며 올바른 비교급 표현이다. ⓓ less + 원급 형용사의 비교급 표현이므로 less likely는 옳다.

body:
밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것을 골라 기호를 쓰고 바르게 고치시오.
Daniel wanted to be a professional chef when he was in high school. He was only interested in cooking at home. He always acted as if he
ⓐwere going to open his own restaurant, but he didn't like cleaning the kitchen. If Daniel had realized how much effort it ⓑwould take to become a skilled chef, he ⓒwould study much harder in school. His teacher suggested that he
ⓓpractice new recipes every week, but he didn't try hard either. Now, Daniel ⓔhas been working at a grocery store for four years.
→
solution: ⓒ은 'If Daniel had realized(가정법 과거완료)~, he would study'로 쓰였으나 주절이 나타내는 시점도 과거(학창 시절)이므로 'would have studied'로 고쳐야 한다. ⓐ은 as if 가정법 과거로 were가 적절하고, ⓑ는 과거 시점에서 예상한 미래를 나타내므로 would take가 옳으며, ⓓ는 suggest that절에서 동사원형을 쓰는 것이 맞고, ⓔ는 현재완료진행형으로 '4년 동안 계속 일해오고 있다'는 의미를 올바르게 나타낸다.

body:
빈칸에 가장 알맞은 것을 고르시오.
They hadn't left early, so they missed the train. If they had left early, they _____ .
solution: If they had left early가 과거 사실의 반대를 가정하므로 주절에는 would have + p.p.가 와야 한다. 또한 일찍 떠났다면 기차를 놓치지 않았을 것이라는 의미이므로 wouldn't have missed가 알맞다. 미래엔(김) 4과 문법 정복 실전
choices: would have missed
would miss
wouldn't have missed
wouldn't miss
will miss 교과서 문법 정복 실전 학습

body:
빈칸에 가장 알맞은 것을 고르시오.
Sarah would have studied chemistry if she _____ its value.
solution: 주절이 would have studied이므로 과거 사실의 반대를 가정하는 가정법 과거완료 문장이다. 따라서 if절에는 had + p.p. 형태인 had recognized가 알맞다.
choices: recognizes
had recognized
will recognize
has recognized
would have recognized

body:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?
May is Skin Cancer Awareness Month. This year, about 100,000 Americans will receive the
ⓐfrightening news that they have melanoma, the most dangerous form of skin cancer. The average age of diagnosis for melanoma is 65 years — 10 years ⓑlate than the average age of diagnosis 30 years ago. People who have a family history of skin cancer need to be ⓒmore carefully monitored and should have annual skin checkups beginning at the age of 20 (for other people, checkups should begin at age 30). There is good news. In recent years, dermatologists have
ⓓdeveloped much better methods for detecting skin cancer early, and new treatments have made survival rates ⓔsignificantly higher than before.
solution: ⓑ 'late'는 뒤에 'than'이 이어지므로 원급이 아니라 비교급 'later'로 써야 한다. ⓐ 'frightening'은 명사 'news'를 수식하는 형용사로 올바르다. ⓒ 'more carefully'는 부사의 비교급으로 'monitored'를 수식하며 올바르다. ⓓ much better에서 much는 비교급 better를 강조하는 부사로 올바르게 쓰였다. ⓔ 'significantly higher than'은 부사 'significantly'가 비교급 형용사 'higher'를 수식하는 올바른 표현이다.

body:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
Team members often concern themselves more with office politics ⓐas with the actual project goals, and this will be a ⓑharder problem to fix once trust is broken. Still, honest communication remains the ⓒbest way of truly rebuilding trust,
ⓓin which members support ⓔthemselves through open feedback.
solution: ⓐ as → than concern oneself more with A than with B의 비교급 구문이므로 as를 than으로 고쳐야 한다. ⓑ harder는 비교급 형용사로 명사 problem을 수식한다. ⓒ best는 the와 함께 쓰인 최상급으로 알맞다. ⓓ in which는 앞의 the best way of truly rebuilding trust를 이어 설명한다. ⓔ themselves는 주어 members를 받는 재귀대명사이다.

body:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 괄호 안의 표현을 바르게 배열하시오.
이 금속은 저 금속보다 적어도 7배는 더 부식과 손상에 취약하다.
(more, seven times, to corrosion, susceptible)
→This metal is at least and damage than that metal.
answer: seven times more susceptible to corrosion
solution: 배수 표현은 배수사 + 비교급 + than의 형태로 나타낼 수 있으므로 seven times more susceptible to corrosion이 된다.

body:
다음 문장의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것을 고르시오.
In my mind, J.K. Rowling and Roald Dahl had done
(A) _____ to inspire children to read through imaginative storytelling and creative writing (B) _____ a thousand strict teachers assigning homework ever could.
solution: (A)에는 more ~ than ...의 비교급 구문이 쓰이므로 more가 알맞다. (B)에는 비교 대상을 이끄는 than이 알맞다.
choices: more - than
most - as
as - than
most - than
more - as 교과서 문법 정복 실전 학습

body: 다음 중 빈칸에 best가 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
solution: ⑤ 'as as' 원급 비교 구문으로, 이 자리에는 최상급인 best가 아니라 원급 형용사 good이 들어가야 한다. 따라서 best가 들어갈 수 없다. ① 'the + 최상급 + 명사' 구조로 best가 형용사로 자연스럽게 쓰였다. ② 'the + 서수 + 최상급 + 명사' 구조로 best가 올바르게 쓰였다. ③ 동사 runs를 수식하는 최상급 부사로 best가 쓰였다. ④ 'the + 최상급 + 명사' 구조로 best가 올바르게 쓰였다.
choices: The company offers the _____ service in the industry.
She is the fifth _____ student in her class.
Of all the runners, he runs _____ .
This hotel provides the _____ view of the ocean.
The traffic today isn't as _____ as it was during rush hour.

body: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
solution: ② heavier than Busan → heavier than that of Busan Traffic in Seoul과 비교해야 하는 대상은 Busan 자체가 아니라 Busan의 traffic이므로 that of Busan이 알맞다. ① as + 형용사 + a + 명사 + as 구조로 알맞다. ③ not the least는 ‘조금도 ~않다’라는 의미의 표현으로 알맞다. ④ the most + 형용사 + 복수명사 구조로 알맞다. ⑤ 소유격 our 뒤에 최상급 strictest가 명사를 수식하는 구조로 알맞다.
choices: I'm as skilled a painter as my teacher is.
Traffic in Seoul is heavier than Busan.
There is not the least doubt about his sincerity.
Some of the most brilliant scientists and inventors will attend the seminar.
Our project succeeded because we followed our strictest guidelines.

body:
다음 괄호 안의 표현을 알맞게 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.
The trip wouldn't _____ . (in advance, if, have been cancelled, the weather forecast, they, had checked)
→ _____
answer: have been cancelled if they had checked the weather forecast in advance
solution: 과거 사실에 반대되는 상황을 나타내는 가정법 과거완료 구문이다. if절은 'had+p.p.'(had checked), 주절은 'would have+p.p.'(wouldn't have been cancelled)로 구성하여 '만약 그들이 미리 일기예보를 확인했더라면 여행이 취소되지 않았을 것이다'라는 의미를 완성한다.

body:
다음 문장과 의미가 통하는 가정법 문장을 고르시오.
They won the game only because their coach trained them hard.
solution: 제시문은 '코치가 열심히 훈련시켰기 때문에 경기에서 이겼다'는 실제 사실을 나타낸다. 이를 가정법 과거완료로 바꾸면 '코치가 열심히 훈련시키지 않았다면 이기지 못했을 것이다'라는 의미가 되어야 하므로 ③이 정답이다. ①은 미래 조건문이므로 시제가 맞지 않다. ②는 가정법 과거로 현재의 반대를 나타내므로 틀리다. ④는 훈련시키지 않았어도 이겼을 것이라는 반대의 의미이므로 틀리다. ⑤는 실제로 훈련시키지 않은 것으로 오해하게 하는 반대의 의미이므로 틀리다.
choices: They will win the game if their coach trains them hard.
They would win the game if their coach trained them hard.
If their coach hadn't trained them hard, they wouldn't have won the game.
If their coach hadn't trained them hard, they would have won the game.
They would have won the game if their coach had trained them hard.

body:
[보기]의 사실과 반대되는 상황을 가정하는 문장의 빈칸을 완성하시오.
보기 I can't concentrate now / I didn't take my medicine / I caught a cold / I didn't visit my grandmother / I don't have enough free time

If I hadn't been so busy, _____ .
answer: I would have visited my grandmother
solution: 'I didn't visit my grandmother'라는 과거 사실을 반대로 가정하는 가정법 과거완료 문장이다. If절에 과거완료가 쓰였으므로 주절에는 'would have+p.p.'를 써서 과거 사실과 반대되는 결과를 나타낸다.

body:
[보기]의 사실과 반대되는 상황을 가정하는 문장의 빈칸을 완성하시오.
보기 I can't concentrate now / I didn't take my medicine / I caught a cold / I didn't visit my grandmother / I don't have enough free time

_____ , I wouldn't have felt so sick.
answer: If I had taken my medicine
solution: 'I didn't take my medicine'이라는 과거 사실을 반대로 가정하는 가정법 과거완료 문장이다. 주절이 'wouldn't have+p.p.'이므로 If절에는 'had+p.p.'를 써야 한다.

body:
[보기]의 사실과 반대되는 상황을 가정하는 문장의 빈칸을 완성하시오.
보기 I can't concentrate now / I didn't take my medicine / I caught a cold / I didn't visit my grandmother / I don't have enough free time

If I hadn't gone out in the rain, _____ .
answer: I wouldn't have caught a cold
solution: 'I caught a cold'라는 과거 사실을 반대로 가정하는 가정법 과거완료 문장이다. If절에 과거완료(hadn't gone out)가 쓰였으므로 주절에는 'would have+p.p.'를 써서 과거 사실과 반대되는 결과를 나타낸다.

body:
[보기]의 사실과 반대되는 상황을 가정하는 문장의 빈칸을 완성하시오.
보기 I can't concentrate now / I didn't take my medicine / I caught a cold / I didn't visit my grandmother / I don't have enough free time

_____ , I could exercise every day.
answer: If I had enough free time
solution: 'I don't have enough free time'이라는 현재 사실을 반대로 가정하는 가정법 과거 문장이다. If절에는 과거동사 (had)를, 주절에는 'could+동사원형'을 써서 현재 사실과 반대되는 상황을 나타낸다. 미래엔(김) 4과 문법 정복 실전

body:
다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 적절한 것끼리 짝지어진 것을 고 르시오.
(A) _____ more free time after school, I would join a sports club. I've wanted to play basketball for years, but my schedule is always packed. I wish my school (B) _____ class hours.
solution: (A) 뒤의 주절이 I would join a sports club인 가정법 과거이므로 조건절은 If + 주어 + 과거동사 형태가 되어야 하므로 If I had가 알맞다. (B) 학교가 앞으로 수업 시간을 줄여 주기를 바라는 소망이므로 I wish + 주어 + would + 동사원형 형태인 would shorten이 알맞다. 따라서 ④ If I had - would shorten이 적절하다.
choices: I had - shortened
I had - would shorten
If I had - would have shortened
If I had - would shorten
I had - would have shortened

body:
다음 문장 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수를 고르시오.
ⓐThe board requested that the CEO resigns immediately.
ⓑIt is time you starts studying for the exam.
ⓒI will forgive him if I were you.
ⓓI wish I were fluent in French.
ⓔShe behaves as if she knew the answer already.
solution: ⓓ I wish 뒤에서 현재 사실과 반대되는 소망을 나타내므로 과거형 were가 쓰인 것은 적절하다. ⓔ as if 뒤에서 현재 사실과 반대되는 상황을 나타내므로 과거형 knew가 쓰인 것은 적절하다. ⓐ resigns → resign request가 ‘~할 것을 요청하다’라는 당위의 의미로 쓰였으므로 that절에는 (should) + 동사원형을 써야 한다. ⓑ starts → started It is time + 주어 + 과거동사는 ‘이제 ~해야 할 때이다’라는 뜻을 나타내므로 과거형 started를 써야 한다. ⓒ will forgive → would forgive if I were you는 현재 사실과 반대되는 상황을 나타내는 가정법 과거이므로 주절에는 would + 동사원형을 써야 한다. 따라서 어법상 옳은 문장은 2개이므로 ②이다.
choices: 1개
2개
3개
4개
5개

body:
다음 문장 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수를 고르시오.
ⓐThe manager demanded that the report was submitted immediately.
ⓑIt is time you went to bed.
ⓒI would apologize first if I were you.
ⓓI wish I owned a bigger house.
ⓔHe acts as if he is the boss here.
solution: ⓑ It is time + 주어 + 과거동사는 ‘이제 ~해야 할 때이다’ 라는 뜻을 나타내므로 적절하다. ⓒ 현재 사실과 반대되는 상황을 가정하는 if I were you와 would + 동사원형이 올바르게 쓰였으므로 적절하다. ⓓ I wish 뒤에서 현재 사실과 반대되는 소망을 나타내므로 과거형 owned가 쓰인 것은 적절하다. ⓐ was submitted → be submitted demand가 ‘~할 것을 요구하다’라는 당위의 의미로 쓰였으므로 that절에는 (should) + 동사원형을 써야 한다. 수동태이므로 be submitted가 알맞다. ⓔ is → were 현재 사실과 반대되는 상황을 나타내는 as if 가정법 과거이므로 be동사는 were를 써야 한다. 따라서 어법상 옳은 문장은 3개이므로 ③이다.
choices: 1개
2개
3개
4개
5개

body: 다음 문장 중 어법상 틀린 것을 고르시오.
solution: ② will go → would go If절에 가정법 과거 were not freezing이 쓰였으므로 주절에는 would + 동사원형을 써야 한다. ① I wish + 주어 + could + 동사원형은 현재 실현하기 어려운 소망을 나타내므로 적절하다. ③ If + 주어 + were to + 동사원형은 미래의 일을 가정하는 표현이므로 적절하다. ④ insist가 ‘~해야 한다고 강하게 요구하다’의 뜻으로 쓰였으므로 that절에 동사원형 arrive가 쓰인 것은 적절하다. ⑤ If + 주어 + should + 동사원형은 실현 가능성이 낮은 미래의 일을 가정하는 표현이므로 적절하다.
choices: I wish I could paint like a professional artist.
If it were not freezing outside, I will go jogging.
If you were to lose your job, what would you do?
The director insisted that he arrive early tomorrow.
If the storm should hit tonight, the flights would be canceled.

body: 다음 문장 중 어법상 틀린 것을 고르시오.
solution: ① will drive → would drive If절에 가정법 과거 were not storming이 쓰였으므로 주절에는 would + 동사원형을 써야 한다. ② If + 주어 + should + 동사원형은 실현 가능성이 낮은 미래의 일을 가정하는 표현이므로 적절하다. ③ If + 주어 + were to + 동사원형은 미래의 일을 가정하는 표현이므로 적절하다. ④ insist가 ‘~해야 한다고 강하게 요구하다’의 뜻으로 쓰였으므로 that절에 동사원형 submit이 쓰인 것은 적절하다. ⑤ I wish + 주어 + could + 동사원형은 현재 실현하기 어려운 소망을 나타내므로 적절하다.
choices: If it were not storming, I will drive to the coast.
If the team should lose, the fans would be disappointed.
If you were to inherit a fortune, what would you do?
The manager insisted that she submit the report today.

body:
다음 (A), (B), (C) 각 괄호 안에서 어법상 옳은 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?
• I wish we (A)[have / had] enough time to finish this project.
• If she had known the truth, she would not (B)
[trust / have trusted] him.
• The doctor insisted that the patient (C)[rest / rested] for a week.
solution: (A) I wish 뒤에서 현재 사실과 반대되는 소망을 나타내므로 과거형 had가 알맞다. (B) If절이 가정법 과거완료인 had known이므로 주절은 would have p.p. 형태가 되어야 하므로 have trusted가 알맞다. (C) insist가 ‘~해야 한다고 강하게 요구하다’의 뜻으로 쓰였으므로 that절에는 (should) + 동사원형을 써야 하므로 rest가 알맞다. 따라서 ② had - have trusted - rest가 적절하다.

had - have trusted - rest
